ga: Yɛ shwane ni mli edɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ Baai lɛ laajeɔ nu oya kɛtsɔɔ la ni shwieɔ shi lɛ nɔ fe bɔ ni shishifãi baanyɛ ajie kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni akwɛɔ nɔ be fɛɛ be loo tsei ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ koni amɛkagbo yɛ latsaa ni naa wa lɛ shishi.

english: How do I tell if my crops are getting too much or too little water?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji nu ni miduɔ lɛ miiná nu babaoo loo fioo tsɔ?

english: Plants getting too little water will have dry, curling, or dropping leaves. Plants getting too much water will turn yellow and droop because their roots are drowning and cannot breathe.
ga: Tsei ni nu fioo pɛ amɛnáa lɛ baaná baai ni egbi. curl loo fall off Tsei ni nu babaoo baa amɛnɔ lɛ baatsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛbaagbee shi ejaakɛ shishifãi lɛ miiho ni amɛmiigbɔjɔ.

english: Is it possible to feed my plants fertilizer through the same pipes that give them water?
ga: Ani abaanyɛ atsɔ paipi ni haa amɛ nu lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ aha mi tsei lɛ ŋmɔshi nibii?

english: Yes, this process is called fertigation. Soluble plant nutrients are mixed into the irrigation water supply so that every time the automated system waters your crops, it feeds them at the exact same time.
ga: Hɛɛ, atsɛɔ gbɛ nɛɛ akɛ fɔmɔ nii. Akɛ tsei amli niyenii ni haa nu mli shwieɔ shi lɛ futuɔ nu ni akɛshwieɔ shi lɛ mli. No hewɔ lɛ be fɛɛ be ni otomatik gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ baaha onibii lɛ nu. Tsei lɛ baaye nii yɛ be kome too mli.

english: Yellowing lower leaves usually mean your maize is starving for nitrogen, which is a major food source for plants. When nitrogen is low, the plant moves what little it has from older leaves up to feed the new growth at the top.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baa ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-abele lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii jɛɛhe titri kɛha tsei Kɛji nitrogen faaa Tso lɛ tsiɔ nɔ fioo ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛɔ baai ni egbɔ lɛ amli kɛyaa ŋwɛi koni ekɛha ŋwɛi shweremɔ hee lɛ niyenii.

english: Pepper plants drop their blossoms when they face stress, such as extreme hot weather, prolonged dry spells, or a lack of water during the flowering stage.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baashwie amɛbaai lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ amɛkpe nɔnyɛɛ, tamɔ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ he. Nuu be lɛ sɛɛ tsɛɔ. loo nu ni bɛ yɛ fɔfɔii afeemɔ be mli

english: How can I stop small insects from destroying my corn after I put it in storage?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ matsi kooloi bibii anaa? Te efeɔ tɛŋŋ efiteɔ mi ŋmãa lɛ beni ekpa lɛ sɛɛ?

english: Insects like weevils need moisture and air to survive in grain. If you dry your corn thoroughly under the sun until it is hard before putting it into airtight storage bags, the insects will suffocate and die.
ga: Kplukai tamɔ ŋmeii hia ŋmɔtɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ koni amɛhi shi yɛ dumɔwui amli. Kɛji okɛ ŋmãa lɛ gĩ yɛ hulutsoo be mli kɛyashi ebaawa dani okɛwo vacuum kotoku mli lɛ, Kooloi lɛ baafo ni amɛgboi.

english: Why do my harvested cassava roots spoil and turn brown inside within just two days?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi ni mikpa lɛ fite ni etsɔ ŋmɔtɔ yɛ gbii enyɔ pɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots start to rot quickly after harvest because they lose water rapidly and react to oxygen once detached from the living plant. Processing them into gari or flour quickly prevents this loss.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ jeɔ shishi amɛgboiɔ oya kɛji akpa amɛ. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, amɛfiteɔ nu oya, ni amɛkɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni ji oxygen lɛ feɔ ekome kɛ́ amɛtse amɛhe kɛjɛ tsei ni hiɛ ka lɛ ahe. Nibii ni afeɔ oya ni akɛfeɔ gari loo ashikishaŋ lɛ tsiɔ nɛkɛ laajemɔ nɛɛ naa.

english: Groundnuts are legumes that have special tiny nodules on their roots that take nitrogen from the air and trap it in the soil, acts as a natural fertilizer for crops like maize.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni yɔɔ ŋmeii bibii. Nɔ krɛdɛɛ yɛ shishifãi lɛ anɔ Eheɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Etsuɔ nii akɛ adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmãa.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot in the ground when heavy rain falls for a long time?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii shishifãi fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ́ nugbɔ nɛ waa be kakadaŋŋ lɛ?

english: Excess water fills up air pockets in the soil, causing the roots to suffocate and drown. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater drain away safely.
ga: Nu ni fa fe nine lɛ eyiɔ kɔɔyɔɔ kotokui ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ amli obɔ. Enɛ haa shishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛshwieɔ nu mli. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ko ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa shweshweeshwe.

english: If you bury seeds too deeply, they exhaust all their stored energy trying to push through the heavy soil and often die before ever reaching sunlight.
ga: Kɛji ofu dumɔwu lɛ mli tsɔ Dumɔwui lɛ baafite hewalɛ fɛɛ ni amɛto lɛ kɛtsɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛaatsi amɛhe waa lɛ nɔ. ni bei pii lɛ amɛgboiɔ dani hulu la lɛ shɛɔ amɛnɔ

english: Yam leaves need direct sunlight to produce energy for growing big tubers underground. Staking keeps the leaves off the damp ground so they catch sunlight and avoid soil-borne diseases.
ga: Sweet potato baai lɛ he miihia hulu la tɛ̃ɛ koni amɛná hewalɛ kɛha bulbs ni miida yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ. Staking baaha tsei lɛ ahe tsei lɛ akashɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ koni enyɛ ená hulu la ni ekɛtsi ehe kɛjɛ helai ni jɛɔ sũ mli baa lɛ ahe.

english: Why do my crop leaves curl up and wilt during the afternoon sun even if the ground has water?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mitso lɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛshwieɔ shi yɛ shwane hulu lɛ mli eyɛ mli akɛ nu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ moŋ?

english: During hot afternoons, plants lose water into the air faster than roots can draw it up, so leaves temporarily curl to protect themselves from heat before recovering in the evening.
ga: Yɛ shwane mli ni hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ Tsei shwieɔ nu kɛyaa kɔɔyɔɔ mli oya fe bɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ajie, no hewɔ lɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ amɛhe be kukuoo ko koni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ hulutsoo be lɛ he dani amɛhe baajɔ amɛ gbɛkɛ.

english: Why is it bad to let weeds grow around my young crop seedlings early in the season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ oŋmɛɔ gbɛ ni jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ he ni oyɔɔ lɛ? No hewɔ lɛ midumɔwui ni miduɔ yɛ be lɛ shishijee mli lɛ ji nɔ fɔŋ.

english: Young crops are weak and cannot compete with fast-growing weeds for sunlight, water, and soil nutrients, which can permanently stunt the crop's growth.
ga: Tsei bibii lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛkɛ jwɛi ni daa oya lɛ abɔ akaŋ kɛha hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. ni baanyɛ atsĩ tsei adalɛ naa kɛya naanɔ

english: Why do the leaves on my young cocoa trees turn yellow and burn under full sun?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-cacao tsei bibii lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni hulu lɛ miitso lɛ?

english: Young cocoa trees cannot tolerate harsh direct sunlight during their early years. They require shade trees or plantains planted alongside them to filter the light and protect their tender leaves until they grow strong enough.
ga: Kookoo tsei bibii nyɛŋ aŋmɛ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ gbɛ yɛ amɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli. Amɛbiɔ tsei ni haa hulutsoo loo tsei bibii ni adu yɛ amɛmasɛi. koni ekɛjie la ni ebu ehe baai bibii lɛ ahe kɛyashi amɛhe wa bɔ ni sa

english: Yam plants store energy in their roots to produce tubers. Raising the vines on stakes allows the leaves to catch maximum sunlight for food production while keeping them off the wet soil where fungal diseases can rot them.
ga: Sweet potato tsei kɛ hewalɛ toɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli koni amɛwo ŋmeii. Wein tsei ni akwɛɔ yɛ tsei anɔ lɛ haa tsei lɛ ahe tsei lɛ naa hulu la babaoo kɛha niyenii feemɔ. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ehaaa etsɔ ŋmɔtɔ, he ni tsɛŋemɔ helai ni jɛɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai amli baa lɛ baanyɛ aya lɛ.

english: If too many suckers grow around one mother plantain plant, they all compete for the same nutrients and water in the soil, which leads to weak plants and smaller plantain bunches.
ga: Kɛji ŋmeii lɛ fa tsɔ lɛ, dumɔ amɛ yɛ dumɔwu kome he. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiitswa amɛhe adafi koni amɛná niyenii mli hewalɛ kɛ nu ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ. Enɛ haa tsei ni bɛ hewalɛ kɛ plantain tsei bibii baa.

english: Why do I see tiny holes and small caterpillars inside my young maize leaves?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ minaa buji bibii lɛ? kɛ ŋmeii bibii Yɛ mi ŋmãa baai bibii lɛ amli

english: These holes are caused by pests like the Fall Armyworm, which feed on tender leaf tissue inside the stem. Catching them early and spraying recommended bio-pesticides or neem extracts helps protect your yield.
ga: Nɛkɛ bu nɛɛ jɛɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai tamɔ Fall Armyworm, ni yeɔ baa bibii ni yɔɔ tso lɛ mli lɛ. Ni ooomɔ amɛ mra Ni okɛ tsofa ni ji bio-insecticide loo neem extract ni atsɔɔ akɛ agbeɔ lɛ baashwie nɔ lɛ baaye abua ni ebu onibii ahe.

english: Why are the leaves on my pepper plants shrinking and curling up tightly?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miigbɔjɔ ni amɛmiibɔle amɛhe waa lɛ?

english: Leaf curl in peppers is usually caused by small insects like whiteflies or thrips that carry a plant virus. Controlling insect populations early prevents the disease from stopping your plant's growth.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, koolooi bibii tamɔ whiteflies loo thrips ni hiɛɔ muawai yɛ tsei anɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ chili baa baa. Kplukai ayibɔ nɔkwɛmɔ mra Ebaatsi helai anaa koni ekakpa tsei lɛ adalɛ.

english: Tomato flowers drop when the plant gets stressed by extreme heat or inconsistent watering. Keeping the soil evenly moist and mulching around the roots helps the plant retain its flowers and set fruit.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛ́ tso lɛ miihao kɛjɛ la ni mli edɔ waa loo nu ni akɛhaa lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ mli. Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni akɛ ŋmɔtɔ wo shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ewoɔ fɔfɔi ni ewoɔ yibii.

english: Why shouldn't I apply fertilizer on my field when the ground is completely dry?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii woɔ miŋmɔji amli be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ egbi kwraa lɛ?

english: Fertilizer requires soil moisture to dissolve into a liquid form that plant roots can absorb. Applying fertilizer on dry soil can burn plant roots or waste the fertilizer as it evaporates in the heat.
ga: Ehe miihia ni ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ aná ŋmɔtɔ koni etsɔ nu ni tsei shishifãi baanyɛ aŋɔ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii wo shikpɔŋ ni egbi mli lɛ, ebaanyɛ eshã tsei lɛ ashishifãi loo eha ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ afite beni efoɔ yɛ latsaa mli lɛ.

english: Why do my young rice plants look pale green instead of deep dark green?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi dumɔwui lɛ ji eŋɔli ni mli tse yɛ eŋɔli ni mli edɔ najiaŋ lɛ?

english: Pale green leaves usually mean the rice plant lacks nitrogen, which is the main food crop plants need to build leaves and stems. Adding nitrogen fertilizer like urea restores healthy green growth.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ ŋmãa tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛma baai kɛ amɛshishifãi Kɛ́ akɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ urea fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni tsei lɛ adara jogbaŋŋ ekoŋŋ.

english: Legume crops like cowpeas and groundnuts take nitrogen from the air and fix it into the soil through their roots. Planting them first naturally enriches the soil so the next crop gets free nutrients.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas kɛ peanuts lɛ heɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ amɛfiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ́ adu nɛkɛ ŋmɔshi nibii nɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, ebaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ afee ŋmɔshi nii yɛ adebɔɔ naa. No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ baaná niyenii mli hewalɛ ni aheee nɔ ko.

english: Why does cassava start rotting in the soil if I leave it past its harvest time?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni ŋmei jeɔ shishi egboɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛji akɛ akwɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ ŋmaakpamɔ be ni eho lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots are living storage organs. Once fully mature, keeping them in wet soil causes them to absorb excess water and succumb to soil bacteria, causing root rot.
ga: Cassava shishifãi ji gbɔmɔtso mli nibii ni kɛ wala yibii toɔ. Kɛji amɛdara kwraa lɛ Kɛ́ akɛ amɛ to shikpɔŋ ni mli ewo fɔ nɔ lɛ, ebaaha amɛmɔmɔ nu ni fa fe nine ni shikpɔŋ mli helai ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ baaye amɛnɔ kunim. Enɛ haa shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ.

english: When leaves turn yellow, it usually means the plant is lacking nitrogen, which is an essential nutrient crops need to grow strong. This often happens if the soil is poor or if heavy rains have washed the nutrients deeper into the ground where roots cannot reach.
ga: Kɛji baai lɛ tsɔ ŋmɔŋ Bei pii lɛ Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa kɛha tsei adalɛ Bei pii lɛ Enɛ baa mli kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ ehiii loo nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ efɔ niyenii ni he hiaa lɛ kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shɔŋŋ yɛ he ni shishifãi lɛ nyɛɛɛ ashɛ he lɛ.

english: When is the best time to put fertilizer on my field so the rain does not wash it away?
ga: Mɛɛ be ji be ni hi fe fɛɛ ni esa akɛ awo ŋmɔji amli ŋmɔshi nibii koni nugbɔ akashwie amɛ?

english: Apply fertilizer when the soil is already moist after a light shower, but avoid putting it down right before a heavy downpour. Applying it to wet soil helps it dissolve quickly for the roots to soak up without getting washed away by floodwater.
ga: Okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ momo yɛ nugbɔ fioo ko sɛɛ. Shi kaakɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli dani nugbɔ anɛ waa. Kɛ́ akɛwo shikpɔŋ ni efɔ nɔ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa shishifãi lɛ ni amɛshwieɔ oya ni nu afua lɛ shwieee amɛ.

english: When seeds are planted too close together, the crops end up competing against each other for sunlight, soil nutrients, and water. This competition causes the plants to grow thin and weak, resulting in small or poor harvests.
ga: Kɛji adu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ Dumɔwui kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la he akaŋ. Niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ nu mli lɛ, akaŋshii nɛɛ haa tsei feɔ mlɛo ni amɛhe waaa. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji nibii ni afee lɛ fioo loo nɔ ni ehiii.

english: Yam vines need to climb so their leaves can spread out and catch as much sunlight as possible, which gives the plant energy to build big tubers underground. Staking also keeps the foliage off the damp ground, preventing diseases.
ga: Ehe miihia ni akwɔ sweet potato wain tsei lɛ anɔ koni amɛbaai lɛ agbɛ ashwã ni amɛná hulu la babaoo. Enɛ haa tso lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfeɔ bulb agboi yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi. Staking hu yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa tsei ahe tsei lɛ akashwɛɔ yɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ koni helai akabote mli.

english: What is causing tiny holes in the middle leaves of my young maize plants?
ga: Mɛni kɛ buji bibii lɛ baa? Yɛ mi-abɛi tso bibioo lɛ baai lɛ ateŋ

english: Holes in the center leaves of young maize are typically caused by caterpillars such as the Fall Armyworm. They hide inside the central leaves during the day and eat the tender plant tissue, which requires early treatment before severe damage occurs.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii tamɔ Fall Armyworm ji nɔ ni kɛ bu ni yɔɔ ŋmãa baai bibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ baa. Amɛteeɔ amɛhe yɛ baai ni yɔɔ teŋgbɛ lɛ amli yɛ gbi lɛ mli ni amɛyeɔ tso lɛ mli fãji ni yɔɔ blɛoo lɛ. Esa akɛ atsu enɛ he nii mra dani fitemɔ ni naa wa aba.

english: Why do my cocoa trees drop their flowers before they can grow into pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi cacao tsei lɛ miiho fɔfɔi dani amɛdara ni amɛbatsɔ ŋmeii lɛ?

english: Cocoa trees drop their flowers when they experience stress, most commonly caused by prolonged heat, dry soil, or damage from sap-sucking insects. Providing shade trees and protecting young cocoa from pests helps flowers stay on the tree.
ga: Cocoa tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji amɛmiihao. Bei pii lɛ, dɔlɛ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ, shikpɔŋ ni egbi, loo koolooi ni nuɔ nu lɛ fitemɔ ji nɔ ni kɛ enɛ baa. Kɛ́ akɛ hulutsoo ha kookoo tso lɛ ni abu he kɛjɛ kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ ahe lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛhiɔ tso lɛ nɔ.

english: Cassava roots rot when water collects in the soil and cannot drain away after heavy rainfall. The roots suffocate in waterlogged soil because they cannot get oxygen, leading to underground decay.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu bua ehe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni enyɛŋ ejɛ mli yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛ waa sɛɛ. Shishifãi nyɛɛɛ amu yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ amɛnyɛŋ amɛná kɔɔyɔɔ kpakpa. Enɛ haa shikpɔŋ shishi nibii lɛ fiteɔ.

english: Covering soil with dry leaves or grass, known as mulching, acts like a protective blanket. It blocks harsh sunlight from drying out the soil, keeps the roots cool, and prevents weeds from sprouting around your crops.
ga: Atsɛɔ jwɛi ni akɛ baai loo jwɛi ni egbi shwieɔ nɔ lɛ hu akɛ mulching. Etsuɔ nii tamɔ tsɔne ni buɔ mɔ he Etsiɔ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ naa koni ekaha shikpɔŋ lɛ agbi. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni shishifãi lɛ feɔ fɛ̃i ni ehaaa jwɛi akakwɛ̃ yɛ oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ahe.

english: Why is it a bad idea to plant maize on the exact same piece of land every single year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ eji jwɛŋmɔ gbonyo akɛ aaadu ŋmãa yɛ he kome daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting the same crop continuously depletes the specific soil nutrients that plant loves and lets pests that feed on it build up in the soil over time. Rotating different crops keeps the soil balanced and breaks pest cycles.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ yɛ ŋmɔshi nibii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli lɛ baafite shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niyenii pɔtɛɛ ni tso lɛ sumɔɔ lɛ be fɛɛ be. ni eha kooloi ni yeɔ tsei lɛ abua amɛhe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ be ni sa mli. Nibii srɔtoi ni aduɔ lɛ atsakemɔ Eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ekome ni efiteɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai ni baa lɛ.

english: How do I know if the first rainfall of the season is enough for me to start planting?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ yɛ be lɛ mli lɛ fa bɔ ni sa ni mikɛjeɔ dumɔ shishi?

english: Avoid planting after just one light rain, as the ground can quickly dry up again. Dig a small hole about hand-deep into the dirt; if the soil is moist all the way down, it holds enough water to safely sprout your seeds.
ga: Tsi ohe kɛjɛ dumɔ he yɛ nugbɔ fioo ko sɛɛ. shikome pɛ Akɛni shikpɔŋ lɛ baanyɛ agbi oya ekoŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, gbee bu bibioo ko ni miihe ashɛ nine kome kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ kwraa lɛ Shikpɔŋ lɛ baahiɛ nu ni fa bɔ ni sa ni baaha dumɔwui lɛ akwɛ̃ shweshweeshwe.

english: Young cocoa plants need shade to protect them from harsh sunlight and heat. Leaving larger trees or planting shade crops like plantains creates a cooler environment that helps young cocoa survive its early years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ hia hulutsoo koni ebu amɛhe kɛjɛ hulu ni naa wa kɛ latsaa he. Tsei wuji ni ashiɔ loo tsei ni haa hulu tsoɔ tamɔ plantains ni aduɔ lɛ haa shihilɛ ni mli ejɔ baa ni eyeɔ ebuaa kookoo bibii lɛ ni amɛhiɔ shi yɛ shishijee afii lɛ amli.

english: Yam vines need sunlight to make food for growing heavy tubers under the ground. Staking lifts the leaves into the sunlight and off the hot ground, preventing rot and helping you get larger tubers.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la koni amɛha niyenii aha bulbs ni tsii ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ. Staking baaha tsei lɛ ahe tsei lɛ aje kpo yɛ hulu la mli ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ akabɔ he. Etsiɔ fitemɔ naa ni eyeɔ ebuaa bo ni okwɛɔ bulbs wuji.

english: The very first rain is often followed by a short dry spell that can dry out new seedlings. Waiting until the rainy season is fully established ensures the soil stays wet enough for seeds to germinate and survive.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, nugbɔ ni nɛɔ mra fe fɛɛ lɛ nyiɛɔ nugbɔshiimɔ be kuku ni baanyɛ aha dumɔwui heei agbi lɛ sɛɛ. Mɛɛ kɛyashi nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ baagbe naa koni ona nɔmimaa akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ bɔ ni sa koni dumɔwui lɛ akwɛ̃ ni amɛhi shi.

english: Legumes like cowpeas have tiny natural helpers in their roots that take nitrogen from the air and store it in the soil. When the plants harvest or rot, this extra food feeds the soil for the next crop.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas bɛ adebɔɔ mli yelikɛbualɔi fioo komɛi yɛ amɛshishifãi ni gbalaa nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Beni akpaa tsei loo amɛgboiɔ Niyenii krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ aye niyenii kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english: How do I know when my cassava roots are mature enough to harvest under the soil?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male be mli ni mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ dara bɔ ni sa ni manyɛ makpa yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi?

english: Cassava leaves usually begin to turn yellow and drop off naturally when tubers are full-grown. You can also carefully dig out soil around one stem to check if the tubers are thick enough before harvesting.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmei baai lɛ jeɔ shishi amɛfeɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbeeɔ shi yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe beni ŋmeii lɛ daraa lɛ. Obaanyɛ okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu abɔle he. Okɛ hiɛdɔɔ atswa tsei lɛ ahe koni okwɛ kɛji ŋmeii lɛ mli edɔ bɔ ni sa dani okpa.

english: Why do my plantain trees yield smaller fruit bunches when I let all the shoot suckers grow around the mother stem?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi plantain tso lɛ woɔ yibii bibii bibii beni mihaa ŋmeii lɛ fɛɛ kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛ tso lɛ he lɛ?

english: Too many suckers fight with the main plantain tree for soil nutrients, sunlight, and water. Cutting away extra suckers and leaving only one or two lets the main plant put all its energy into growing big fruit.
ga: Ayɛ tsei bibii babaoo tsɔ ni kɛ plantain titri lɛ miitswa akaŋ kɛha niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, hulu la, kɛ nu mli. Kɛ́ afolɔ ŋmeii ni eshwɛ lɛ ni ashi eko loo enyɔ pɛ lɛ, ebaaha tso titri lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ atsu nii ni ekɛwo yibii wuji.

english: Why do tall weeds make my crops grow thin and weak instead of strong?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi ni kɛlɛ lɛ miiha miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ miifee mlɛo ni egbɔjɔ moŋ fe ni eeefee hewalɛ lɛ?

english: Weeds steal light, water, and soil nutrients from your crops. When weeds grow taller than your crops, your crops stretch upward too quickly to reach sunlight, causing them to become spindly.
ga: Jwɛi juɔ la, nu, kɛ sũ mli nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ onibii amli. Kɛ jwɛi lɛ dara fe oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ Oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ baagbɛ eshwa oya tsɔ ni enyɛŋ ená hulu la. tsake lɛ etsɔ ŋmeii

english: Yellow leaves on young maize usually mean the crop lacks nitrogen, an essential soil nutrient. Adding compost, animal manure, or nitrogen fertilizer helps the leaves turn dark green and healthy again.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa bibii anɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii, ŋmɔshi nibii, loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni baai lɛ atsɔ ŋmɔji ni tsuɔ nii waa ni amɛná hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.

english: Tomato flowers drop when the air gets too hot, water is inconsistent, or tiny pests attack the flowers. Keeping soil moist and protecting blossoms from pests helps flowers set into tomatoes.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔ tsɔ. Nu lɛ ejaaa. aloo kooloi bibii ni yeɔ mɔ awui yɛ Ba ni obatutua fɔfɔi lɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni akwɛɔ nɔ jogbaŋŋ ni abuɔ fɔfɔi lɛ ahe kɛjɛɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai ahe lɛ yeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ tomato he.

english: Leaf curling in peppers is usually caused by tiny insect pests like thrips or whiteflies sucking juices from under the leaves. Controlling these insects early keeps the leaves flat and healthy.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii bibii tamɔ thrips loo whiteflies ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ baai lɛ ashishi lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ ŋmeii amli. Nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ anɔyeli mra Ebaaha baai lɛ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni amɛhe awa.

english: Why shouldn't I just scatter my maize seeds on the field the old way instead of planting them in neat rows with exact spacing?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ mikɛ ŋmãa dumɔwui shwieɔ miŋmɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ gbɛ ni tamɔ nakai nɔŋŋ nɔ lɛ? Mohu ɔ, mo du mɛ ngɛ blɔhi a nɔ saminya nɛ a kɛ a kpɛti kake.

english: Planting in straight rows with proper spacing ensures each plant gets enough sunlight, water, and soil nutrients without choking its neighbors, making weeding easier and significantly increasing your harvest.
ga: Kɛ́ adu amɛ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ ni ja ni gbɛ ni sa yɔɔ mli lɛ, ehaa tso fɛɛ tso naa hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni eyeee ekutsoŋbii lɛ anɔ kunim. Enɛ haa jwɛi lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ feɔ mlɛo ni ehaa yibiiwoo yaa hiɛ waa.

english: What is the best way to prepare my land before the major rainy season starts so my crop roots can grow deep?
ga: Mɛni ji gbɛ ni hi fe fɛɛ ni matsɔ nɔ masaa mishikpɔŋ lɛ dani nugbɔshiimɔ be ni he hiaa lɛ aje shishi koni mitso lɛ shishifãi lɛ anyɛ adara kɛya shɔŋŋ?

english: Clearing weeds and plowing or loosening the topsoil allows rainwater to soak deep into the ground and makes it easy for young roots to push through and search for food.
ga: Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛi kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni ajieɔ loo ajieɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu lɛ boteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ ni ehaa shishifãi bibii lɛ boteɔ mli ni amɛnaa niyenii.

english: Why do extension officers advise me to buy certified seeds from the store instead of saving seeds from my previous harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ extension nitsulɔi lɛ woɔ mi ŋaa akɛ mahe dumɔwui ni awo he odaseyeli lɛ kɛjɛ shwapo ko mli lɛ? Mohu ɔ, mo ngɔ dumɔwuhi nɛ je ngma kpami nɛ be ɔ mi ɔ kɛ to.

english: Certified seeds are specially tested to resist common local diseases, withstand dry spells better, and give uniform, higher yields compared to saved seeds, which lose their strength over time.
ga: Akwɛɔ dumɔwui ni awo he odase lɛ mli krɛdɛɛ koni ana kɛji amɛnyɛŋ amɛye helai ni afɔɔ namɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ anɔ. Enyɛɔ eshiɔ hɔmɔ shihilɛi babaoo. ni amɛwoɔ yibii ni yaa nɔ daa ni fa fe dumɔwui ni ato he gbɛjianɔ lɛ. ni baafite hewalɛ yɛ be ni sa mli

english: The very first rain is often followed by a long dry hot spell, which can dry out and kill tiny newly germinated seeds before the actual rainy season fully settles.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, nugbɔshiimɔi ni nɛɔ mra lɛ nyiɛɔ be kakadaŋŋ ni mli edɔ kɛ nugbɔshiimɔi sɛɛ. Enɛ baanyɛ aha dumɔwui heei ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ agbi ni egbe amɛ dani nugbɔshiimɔ be diɛŋtsɛ lɛ aba naagbee.

english: Why do my yam tubers grow smaller and weaker every year when I plant them on the exact same piece of land?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potato tsei lɛ feɔ bibii ni amɛhe waaa daa afi kɛ́ midu amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ lɛ?

english: Planting the same crop on the same spot every year drains the exact same nutrients from the soil and allows pests to build up; changing crops each season allows the soil to recover.
ga: Tsei komekomei ni aduɔ yɛ he kome afi fɛɛ afi lɛ jieɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eyeɔ ebuaa kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ ni amɛtoɔ amɛhe shi. Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ ni atsakeɔ yɛ be fɛɛ mli lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tseɔ ekoŋŋ.

english: How can I tell if my soil is tired and needs organic manure before I start planting my vegetables?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ etse ni ehe miihia ni akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli dani mabɔi aduawai adumɔ?

english: Tired soil often turns light-colored or hard, loses moisture quickly after rain, and grows pale, stunted crops; mixing in animal manure or compost restores nutrients and holds soil moisture.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni efite lɛ feɔ blɛoo loo shikpɔŋ ni wa. Moisture ni laajeɔ oya yɛ nugbɔ sɛɛ. ni ehaa ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni ehaa ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ futu mli lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni niyenii mli hewalɛ aku sɛɛ aba ni eha sũ lɛ mli ŋmɔtɔ ahi shi.

english: Why are the leaves on my cassava plants turning yellow and curling up even when there is plenty of rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-cassava tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛmiibɔle amɛhe yɛ nugbɔ babaoo ni nɛɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Yellow, curling leaves are a sign of a viral disease spread by tiny whiteflies, not a lack of water; removing infected plants early stops the disease from spreading to healthy crops.
ga: Baai ni ebɔle ehe lɛ ji hela ko ni ŋmeii bibii ni yɔɔ tsɛŋemɔ hela mli lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ he okadi. Jeee nu ni faaa yɛ mɔ mli. Tsei ni hela lɛ emɔmɔ amɛ lɛ ni ajieɔ mra Enɛ baatsi hela lɛ naa koni ekagbɛ eshwa ŋmɔshi nibii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ amli.

english: Why do insects attack my stored cowpeas even after I dry them very well under the hot sun?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kooloi bibii miitutua mi-cowpeas ni mikɛto lɛ eyɛ mli akɛ migbiɔ amɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi lɛ?

english: Sun drying removes moisture, but insect eggs laid on crops while still in the field can survive and hatch inside storage bags unless airtight containers or safe storage powders are used.
ga: Kɛ́ egbi yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ejieɔ ŋmɔtɔ. Shi kooloi bibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔshi nibii anɔ beni amɛyɔɔ ŋmɔ mli lolo lɛ baanyɛ ahi shi ni amɛfɔ yɛ nibii ni akɛtoɔ kotokui amli lɛ amli. Ja akɛ nɔ ko ni kɔɔyɔɔ nyɛŋ abote mli loo powda ni akɛtoɔ nii ahe ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe tsu nii.

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings dry up and die during the harmattan season while my neighbor's seedlings survive?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cocoa tsei bibii lɛ gbɛ́ɔ ni amɛgboiɔ yɛ harmattan be mli yɛ be mli ni mikutsoŋnyo lɛ dumɔwui lɛ yɛ wala mli lolo lɛ?

english: Young cocoa trees have soft stems and burn easily in harsh sun; planting plantains next to them creates living shade umbrellas that protect them from heat and retain moisture.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ ashishifãi yɛ bɔdɔɔ, ni hulu la ni naa wa lɛ shãa oya. Dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ masɛi Amɛbaafee hulutsoo ni buɔ amɛhe kɛjɛɔ latsaa he ni ehaa ŋmɔtɔ hiɔ shi.

english: Why does my tomato plant produce plenty of bushy green leaves but very few actual fruits?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tso lɛ miiwo baai eŋɔlii babaoo shi yibii diɛŋtsɛ fioo pɛ ewoɔ lɛ?

english: Using too much nitrogen fertilizer causes the plant to spend all its energy growing big leaves instead of flowers, or severe heat causes the flowers to drop off before setting fruit.
ga: Kɛ́ akɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo tsu nii lɛ, ebaaha tso lɛ afite ehewalɛ fɛɛ ni ekɛbaakwɛ baai wuji yɛ fɔfɔi najiaŋ. Aloo la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ haa fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi dani aduawai lɛ shwieɔ shi.

english: Young cocoa plants have tender leaves that burn easily under full sun. Planting fast-growing shade crops like plantains alongside your cocoa creates a protective canopy that provides shade and preserves soil moisture.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ baai bibii ni shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni naa wa shishi. Kɛ́ adu tsei ni shwereɔ oya tamɔ plantains yɛ kookoo masɛi lɛ, ehaa hulutsoo baa ni ehaa sũ lɛ mli nu lɛ hiɔ shi.

english: Yellowing leaves usually mean your maize crop lacks nitrogen, which is the main food plants need to build green leaves. Applying nitrogen fertilizer or compost will help your maize regain its green color and yield larger ears.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-corn lɛ mli. Enɛ ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛwo baai eŋɔli. Nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ ni akɛaatsu nii lɛ baaye abua ni ŋmãa lɛ atsɔ eŋɔli ni ekɛ toi wuji aba.

english: Cassava roots rot when standing water collects around them for too long. Planting your cassava on raised soil mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater drain away so the roots remain dry and healthy.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu ni ekã shi lɛ bua amɛhe naa be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa. No hewɔ lɛ, shishifãi lɛ hiɔ shi ni amɛgbiɔ ni amɛhe wa.

english: What is causing small holes in the leaves and center stems of my maize crop?
ga: Mɛni kɛ buji bibii lɛ baa? Yɛ mi ŋmãa lɛ baai kɛ teŋgbɛ tso lɛ nɔ.

english: These holes are typically caused by fall armyworms, a common caterpillar pest. Checking your field early and applying recommended biopesticides or neem extract solutions will protect your maize before the damage worsens.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, fall armyworms ji nɔ ni kɛ buji nɛɛ baa. ni ji ŋmeii ni fɔɔ baa Onibii ni odu lɛ amli kwɛmɔ mra Ni tsofa ni gbeɔ ŋmeii loo neem mli nu ni ajieɔ yi lɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ baaye abua ni abu o-ŋmã lɛ he dani nɔ ni efite lɛ aya hiɛ waa.

english: Why shouldn't I plant my seeds very close together so I can harvest more crops?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miduɔ midumɔwui lɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe koni maná ŋmaa babaoo?

english: When seeds are planted too close together, the crops fight each other for sunlight, water, and soil nutrients. Proper spacing gives each plant room to grow strong and produce larger harvests.
ga: Kɛ dumɔwui lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Tsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la, nu, kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ he lɛ yeɔ ebuaa tsũ fɛɛ tsũ ni daa lɛ mli hewalɛ ni ewoɔ yibii babaoo.

english: How do weeds hurt my farm if I leave them growing next to my crops?
ga: Te jwɛi baanyɛ aye miŋmɔ lɛ awui eha tɛŋŋ kɛji miha amɛkwɛ̃ yɛ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ahe?

english: Weeds steal fertilizer, water, and sunlight meant for your crops, while also harboring harmful insects. Clearing weeds early ensures your crops get all the food and light they need to produce a good harvest.
ga: Jwɛi juɔ ŋmɔshi nibii, nu, kɛ hulu la ni ato he gbɛjianɔ kɛha onibii lɛ. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, eji he ko hu ni kooloi bibii ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ hiɔ. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ mra Eyeɔ ebuaa ni okwɛɔ koni oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aná niyenii kɛ la ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛwo yibii kpakpai.

english: Tomato flowers drop when the plants experience severe heat stress or irregular watering. Keeping the soil consistently moist and putting dry leaves around the base as mulch helps the plant retain its flowers and set fruit.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛji tso lɛ na dɔlɛ ni naa wa loo nu ni akɛhaa lɛ be fɛɛ be. Kɛ́ aha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni akɛ baai ni egbi fɔ̃ɔ shishigbɛ kɛtsɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ nɔ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ehiɛɔ efɔfɔi kɛ eyibii lɛ amli.

english: How do I choose the best yam sets to plant for next season?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ mahala sweet potatoes ni hi fe fɛɛ ni mikɛbaadu yɛ be ni baa lɛ mli?

english: Select firm, healthy yam tubers that show active sprouts and have no soft spots, insect holes, or rot. Healthy planting seed prevents diseases from spreading into your soil and leads to stronger yam vines.
ga: Halamɔ sweet potato tsei ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni miikwɛ̃ ni bɛ he ko ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ, kooloi amli ŋmeii, loo ŋmeii. Dumɔwui kpakpai ni ooodu lɛ baatsi hela naa koni ekagbɛ eshwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaha o-sweet potato wain tso lɛ mli awa.

english: Why are the leaves on my pepper plants curling up and stopping the plants from growing?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miihoso ni amɛmiikpa tso lɛ dalɛ?

english: Leaf curling in pepper plants is usually caused by tiny insects like whiteflies that transmit viruses. Controlling these insects early using insecticidal soap or recommended sprays will keep the leaves flat and healthy.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ whiteflies ni gbɛɔ helai ni baa mɔ mli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni shwieɔ shi yɛ pepper tsei amli lɛ baa. Nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ anɔkwɛmɔ mra Kɛ akɛ samla loo tsofa ni akɛshwieɔ kooloi anɔ ni atsɔɔ akɛ akɛgbeɔ kooloi lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni baa lɛ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni ehi shi jogbaŋŋ.

english: How does planting cowpeas or groundnuts together with my main crops improve the soil?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ tsina loo ŋmeii ni mikɛ miŋmɔshi nibii titrii lɛ baadu lɛ baanyɛ aye abua ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aya hiɛ?

english: Legumes like cowpeas and groundnuts pull nitrogen gas from the air and fix it into the soil through their roots. This naturally enriches the land with plant food for cereal crops like maize or millet.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas kɛ peanuts gbalaa nitrogen gas kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ amɛfiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ nii babaoo yɛ adebɔɔ naa kɛ tsei niyenii kɛha ŋmaa ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmãa loo ŋmãa.

english: Why do my maize plants turn yellow and stay small when I do not add fertilizer?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-ŋmei lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni ehiɔ shi bibioo kɛ́ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii wooo mli lɛ?

english: Maize plants need essential nutrients like nitrogen from the soil to grow strong and green. When soil nutrients are depleted, investing in fertilizer provides the necessary plant food for healthy growth and larger cobs.
ga: Niyenii ni he hiaa tamɔ nitrogen ni jɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he miihia ŋmãa tsei koni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ ni amɛfee eŋɔli. Beni niyenii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ ba shi lɛ Kɛ́ okɛ shika wo ŋmɔshi nibii amli lɛ, ebaaha otsei lɛ aná niyenii ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ ni amɛfee ŋmeii wuji.

english: Is it worth spending extra money to buy certified seeds instead of saving seeds from my last harvest?
ga: Ani sɛɛnamɔ yɛ he akɛ abaafite shika ni fa lɛ koni akɛhe dumɔwui ni awo he odaseyeli lɛ? Mohu ɔ, i ngɔ dumɔwu komɛ kɛ je ye nyagbe kpami ɔ mi.

english: Yes, certified seeds are specifically bred to resist local pests, tolerate drought, and give higher yields. Investing in quality seeds at the start leads to a harvest that earns back far more than the seed cost.
ga: Hɛɛ, atsɔse dumɔwui ni awo he odaseyeli lɛ pɔtɛɛ koni amɛte shi amɛwo maŋ lɛ mli kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ. Enyɛɔ eshiɔ hɔmɔ ni ehaa yibiiwoo babaoo Kɛ́ akɛ shika wo dumɔwui ni hi jogbaŋŋ amli kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, ebaaha akpa ŋmɔshi nibii ni sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he babaoo fe dumɔwui lɛ ahe nyɔmɔwoo.

english: Why should I spend time and money clearing weeds around my crops if weeds are just natural plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafite be kɛ shika kɛji jwɛi ji adebɔɔ mli nɔ ko kɛkɛ?

english: Weeds compete directly with your crops for soil nutrients, water, and sunlight. Removing weeds ensures your crops get all the food they need to produce a full harvest.
ga: Jwɛi kɛ otsei lɛ yeɔ akaŋ tɛ̃ɛ koni amɛná niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ, nu, kɛ hulu la mli lɛ. Kɛtsɔ jwɛi ni ooojie lɛ nɔ lɛ, oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ naa niyenii fɛɛ ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛwo amɛŋmɔshi nibii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.

english: Leaf curling is usually caused by tiny insects like thrips or whiteflies sucking sap from the leaves, or by viral infections. Treating the plants early stops the damage so the crop can continue producing peppers.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ thrips loo whiteflies ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ baai lɛ amli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baa lɛ shwieɔ shi. aloo kɛjɛ hela ko ni gbeɔ mɔ mli Tsei lɛ atsamɔ mra Enɛ baaye abua ni akpa nɔ ni efite lɛ koni ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aya nɔ awo ŋmeii.

english: Extreme heat stresses tomato plants and dries out pollen, preventing flowers from forming fruit. Keeping the soil moist and providing light shade helps the plant hold its flowers and produce fruit.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ haa tomato tsei lɛ haoɔ ni ehaa pollen lɛ gbɛ́ɔ. Tsi fɔfɔii anaa koni amɛkawo yibii Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ efee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni ehiɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ewoɔ fɔfɔi ni ewoɔ yibii.

english: Why do my plantain leaves dry out and droop during the harmattan dry season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi plantain baai lɛ gbɛ́ɔ ni amɛshwieɔ shi yɛ harmattan hɔmɔ be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Dry harmattan winds pull moisture out of large leaves faster than roots can absorb it. Applying mulch around the plant base retains soil moisture and keeps the plantain growing.
ga: Harmattan kɔɔyɔɔ ni egbi lɛ gbalaa nu kɛjɛɔ baai wuji amli oya fe bɔ ni shishifãi lɛ baanyɛ aŋɔ. Mulching ni akɛwoɔ tsei lɛ ashishi lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ŋmɔtɔ hiɔ shi ni ewoɔ dumɔwui lɛ hewalɛ koni amɛshwere.

english: How does planting groundnuts or beans in my farm make the soil better for my next crop?
ga: Te abaafee tɛŋŋ ni ŋmeii loo ŋmeii ni aduɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ aha shikpɔŋ lɛ afee nɔ ni hi kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Legume plants like groundnuts capture nitrogen from the air and store it in their roots. When the plant dies, that nitrogen enriches the soil naturally, saving you money on chemical fertilizers for your next crop.
ga: Legumes tamɔ ŋmei lɛ mɔ̃ɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛtoɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli. Kɛ́ tso lɛ gbo lɛ, nakai nitrogen lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔshi nii yɛ adebɔɔ naa. Eyeɔ ebua bo ni okɛ shika toɔ tsofa ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli kɛha oŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ ahe.

english: How do I know when my cassava roots are mature enough to harvest and sell?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male be mli ni mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ dara bɔ ni sa ni manyɛ makpa ni mahɔ̃ɔ?

english: Cassava is usually ready when lower leaves turn yellow and drop off, and the soil around the stem base cracks open. Harvesting at full maturity ensures the tubers have high starch content, which fetches better market prices.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, Yucca lɛ efee klalo kɛ́ shishigbɛ baai lɛ batsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbee shi. ni shikpɔŋ ni bɔle tso lɛ shishi lɛ mli etse Nikpamɔ kɛji eda kwraa lɛ woɔ ŋmeii ni starch babaoo yɔɔ mli. ni haa jara ni hi fe fɛɛ yɛ jara nɔ

english: Why do my harvested maize cobs get destroyed by insects when I store them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni ŋmeii yeɔ mi-ŋmãa ni akpa lɛ nɔ kɛ́ mikɛto lɛ?

english: Insects thrive when stored grain is not completely dry. Sun-drying your maize until the kernels are hard before storing stops insects from breeding and preserves your crop for sale later.
ga: Kplukai shwereɔ jogbaŋŋ kɛ́ dumɔwui ni ato lɛ egbiko kwraa. Okɛ ŋmãa agbi kɛyashi ŋmãa lɛ baafee shiŋŋ dani okɛto koni kooloi akafɔ ni okɛ ŋmãa lɛ ato koni sɛɛ mli lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ.

english: Black pod disease is caused by a fungus that spreads rapidly in dark, damp conditions. Pruning shade trees to let sunlight and air flow through the farm keeps pods dry and prevents infection.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ black pod hela baa ji ŋmei ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni duŋ yɔɔ, ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ. Kɛ́ afo tsei ni haa hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ tsɔɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa ŋmeii lɛ agbiɔ ni ehaa helai baa mɔ nɔ.

english: Why do my maize plants turn yellow and stop growing well when they are still very young?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele tsei lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛkpaa dalɛ beni amɛdarako kwraa lɛ?

english: Young maize plants turn yellow mainly because the soil lacks enough nitrogen, which is the key nutrient for leaf growth. Giving them a light application of starter fertilizer or well-rotted manure early on gives them the strength to grow deep green and tall.
ga: Abele tsei bibii lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ titri ejaakɛ nitrogen ni fa bɔ ni sa bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa kɛha baai lɛ adalɛ Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ oooha amɛ shishijee ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii fioo ni egbo jogbaŋŋ mra. Enɛ haa amɛnáa hewalɛ ni amɛdaraa ni amɛfeɔ eŋɔli ni amɛdaraa.

english: Why do my tomato plants need different fertilizer when they start flowering compared to when I first transplanted them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ he hiaa ŋmɔshi nibii sɔrɔtoi kɛ́ amɛje fɔfɔii afeemɔ shishi fe be mli ni mikɛ amɛ wo he kroko klɛŋklɛŋ kwraa lɛ?

english: Crops require different nutrients at different stages of life. When young, crops need nutrients that build leafy stems, but once they begin flowering, they need energy focused on producing strong blooms and healthy fruits.
ga: Niyenii srɔtoi he miihia tsei yɛ amɛshihilɛ mli hei srɔtoi. Kɛ amɛji bibii lɛ, niyenii he hiaa tsei koni amɛfee tsei ashishifãi kɛ baai. Shi kɛ́ ebɔi fɔmɔ Tsei lɛ he miihia hewalɛ ni akɛjwɛŋmɔ maa nɔ koni amɛwo fɔfɔi ni mli wa kɛ aduawai ni yɔɔ hewalɛ.

english: Why does the cassava variety my neighbor grows produce tubers in six months, while my local variety takes over a year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mikutsoŋnyo lɛ ŋmei lɛ kwɛ̃ ŋmeii yɛ nyɔji enumɔ mli lɛ? Yɛ be mli ni mimaŋ srɔtoi lɛ heɔ nɔ ni fe afi lɛ?

english: Different crop varieties have distinct genetic traits and growth schedules. Improved crop varieties are specifically bred to mature quickly and yield early, while traditional local varieties naturally take a longer time to complete their growth cycle.
ga: Tsei srɔtoi yɛ fɔmɔ nii kɛ amɛdalɛ be srɔtoi. Akwɛɔ tsei srɔtoi ni afee amɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ pɔtɛɛ koni amɛkwɛ̃ mra ni amɛwo yibii mra. Yɛ be mli ni akutseiaŋ tsofai srɔtoi lɛ heɔ be babaoo dani amɛgbeɔ amɛ adebɔɔ mli dalɛ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa lɛ.

english: How can I find out the correct spacing standard I should use when planting my maize seeds?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male gbɛ ni sa ni esa akɛ mikɛtsu nii kɛji midu ŋmãa dumɔwui?

english: Every crop variety has standard planting guidelines developed by agricultural officers. Following proper spacing ensures each plant gets enough sunlight, soil nutrients, and water without competing with neighboring plants.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ gbɛtsɔɔmɔi ni ato he gbɛjianɔ ni okwaayeli he nitsulɔi lɛ fee. Kɛ́ akwɛ bɔ ni tso lɛ teŋ jɛkɛmɔ yɔɔ ha lɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehaa tso fɛɛ tso nine shɛɔ hulu la nɔ. niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ nu ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛ tsei ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ akaŋ.

english: Why do my pepper plant leaves curl up during the hot dry season in Ghana?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tsei lɛ miihoso yɛ hulutsoo be mli yɛ Ghana lɛ?

english: Pepper plants curl their leaves to reduce water loss and protect themselves from intense heat. This is a natural survival behavior, and providing light shade or regular watering helps the plant recover.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni nu ni amɛfiteɔ lɛ aba shi, ni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa waa he. Enɛ ji adebɔɔ mli wala yiwalaheremɔ subaŋ. Ni kɛ́ okɛ hulutsoo loo nu ha tso lɛ daa lɛ, ebaaye ebua tso lɛ ni ehiɛ aya hiɛ.

english: Why are my garden egg flowers falling off the plant without turning into fruits?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ eggplant fɔfɔi ni yɔɔ mibɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛjɛɔ tso lɛ nɔ ni amɛtsakeee amɛfeɔ aduawai lɛ?

english: Flowers drop off when plants suffer from water stress, extreme heat, or a lack of essential nutrients during the flowering stage. Ensuring steady soil moisture and balanced nutrients helps the plant hold onto its flowers so they mature into fruits.
ga: Fɔfɔii shwieɔ shi kɛji tsei lɛ na piŋmɔ yɛ nu mli haomɔ, dɔlɛ ni naa wa, loo niyenii ni he hiaa ni bɛ yɛ fɔfɔii afeemɔ be mli lɛ hewɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ kɛ niyenii ni ja ni akwɛɔ nɔ daa lɛ yeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛmɔɔ fɔfɔi lɛ ahe koni amɛdara ni amɛwo yibii.

english: Why do my yam vines grow large green leaves above the ground but produce small tubers under the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi sweet potato wain tso lɛ yɛ baai agboi ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ? Shi eyɛ yitso bibioo ko yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi?

english: When crops receive too much nitrogen fertilizer, they direct all their energy into growing big foliage above ground instead of sending energy down to develop thick tubers below the soil.
ga: Kɛ tsei nine shɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo nɔ lɛ Hewalɛ fɛɛ kɛ ejwɛŋmɔ maa tsei wuji ni yɔɔ baai ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeetsu hewalɛ kɛba shi koni ekɛfee ŋmeii ni mli tse yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ.

english: Why do some of my plantain suckers rot in the soil instead of sprouting into new plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi plantain tsei lɛ ekomɛi miifite yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni amɛakwɛ̃ ni amɛfee tsei heei lɛ?

english: Suckers rot when planted in heavy, waterlogged soil where roots cannot breathe, or if the planting material was damaged. Planting healthy, clean suckers in well-drained soil ensures fast and safe sprouting.
ga: Suckers lɛ fiteɔ kɛji akɛ adu amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ waa yɛ he ni shishifãi lɛ nyɛɛɛ amu lɛ. aloo kɛji akɛ nibii ni akɛduɔ lɛ efite Kɛ́ adu tsei ni he tse ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nu hoɔ yɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ekwɛ̃ɔ oya ni ehiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.

english: Why do the lower leaves of my young cocoa trees turn brown and drop during heavy rainfall?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cacao tsei bibii lɛ ashishigbɛ baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni amɛshwieɔ shi yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Excessive humidity and wet soil encourage fungal diseases to attack the leaves where air flow is low. Clearing weeds and pruning surrounding shade helps air circulate and keeps the cocoa leaves dry and healthy.
ga: Fɛ̃i ni fa fe nine kɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli efɔ lɛ woɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai ni haa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ hewalɛ koni amɛtutua baai ni kɔɔyɔɔ eyaaa nɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ. Kɛ́ ajieɔ jwɛi kɛ ŋmeii ni ebɔle he lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ, ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa kookoo baai lɛ agbiɔ ni amɛhiɛɔ hewalɛ.

english: How do I know how much water my cabbage crop requires throughout its growth cycle?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male nu abɔ ni he hiaa mi-cabbage tsei lɛ yɛ amɛdalɛ be lɛ fɛɛ mli?

english: Cabbages have shallow root systems, and standard care guidelines recommend keeping the topsoil constantly moist but never flooded. Water needs increase as the cabbage head begins to form and swell.
ga: Kaabaji yɛ shishifãi ni mli ekwɔɔɔ. Ni gbɛtsɔɔmɔi ni kɔɔ bɔ ni akwɛɔ nɔ ahaa lɛ he lɛ woɔ ŋaa akɛ, esa akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fã lɛ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ be fɛɛ be shi nu afua akaho kɔkɔɔkɔ. Nu he hiamɔ yaa hiɛ be mli ni kaabe yitsei lɛ jeɔ shishi amɛfeɔ amɛhe ni amɛfuɔ lɛ.

english: How do I know if my crops need fertilizer or if they are sick from a disease?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ he miihia amɛ loo helai miipiŋ amɛ?

english: Yellowing leaves usually mean nutrient deficiency, while spots, mold, or rotting parts point to disease. Checking under leaves and on stems helps identify whether you need fertilizer or crop medicine.
ga: Baai ŋmɔŋ tsɔɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ ni faaa, yɛ be mli ni ŋmɔtɔ, ŋmei, loo fitemɔ tsɔɔ hela. Kɛ́ okwɛ baai kɛ tsei lɛ ashishigbɛ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni onaa kɛji akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo tsofa ni akɛwoɔ tsei amli lɛ he miihia bo.

english: Can I still grow healthy crops on land where my harvest failed last season?
ga: Ani manyɛ madu ŋmɔshi nibii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lolo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikpamɔ lɛ shɛɛɛ nɔ yɛ afi ni ho lɛ mli lɛ nɔ?

english: Yes, you can revive poor soil by adding organic manure, clearing weeds, and planting nitrogen-fixing crops like groundnuts or cowpeas to restore nutrients before planting your main crop again.
ga: Hɛɛ, obaanyɛ okɛ shikpɔŋ ni ehiii lɛ aku sɛɛ aba kɛtsɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛbaafata he, jwɛi ni ooojie kɛjɛ mli, kɛ tsei ni haa nitrogen hiɔ shi tamɔ ŋmei loo tsina ŋmei ni ooodu lɛ nɔ. Koni okɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ aku sɛɛ aba dani odu otso titri lɛ ekoŋŋ.

english: What makes soil turn sour or bad for crops, and how can I fix it?
ga: Mɛni haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ acid loo ehiii kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii? Ni te mafee tɛŋŋ masaa?

english: Soil becomes sour or acidic from continuous farming and heavy chemical use, which stops crops from taking up food. Adding agricultural lime or organic compost fixes the soil so crops can grow strong.
ga: Shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ ŋmɔlɔ loo ŋmɔlɔ ni jɛɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni yaa nɔ kɛ tsofai ni tsii ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ mli baa. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ nyɛɛɛ aye niyenii. Kɛ́ akɛ okwaayeli mli lime loo organic compost fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni etsake shikpɔŋ lɛ koni ŋmɔshi nibii akwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why do the leaves of my cassava plants fold up during the heat of the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane ni hulu tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava leaves fold in extreme heat to protect themselves from losing water. It is a natural defence mechanism the plant uses to conserve moisture until the sun cools down.
ga: Akɛ cassava baai lɛ fɔ̃ɔ nu ni mli edɔ lɛ mli koni nu lɛ akafite. Eji adebɔɔ mli hebuu gbɛ ni tsei kɛtsuɔ nii koni amɛhiɛ ŋmɔtɔ mli kɛyashi hulu lɛ mli jɔɔ.

english: Weeds are wild plants adapted to survive harsh conditions. They aggressively steal sunlight, water, and soil nutrients faster than your young crops can absorb them.
ga: Jwɛi ji koo mli tsei ni atsake amɛ koni amɛhi shi yɛ shihilɛi ni mli wawai amli. Amɛjuɔ hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ nii kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli oya fe bɔ ni otsei bibii lɛ baanyɛ aŋɔ.

english: Why do my corn plants grow tall and thin with tiny ears when I plant many seeds together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele tsei lɛ kɛlɛ ni amɛhe yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni amɛtoi bibii yɔɔ mli beni mikɛ dumɔwui babaoo feɔ ekome lɛ?

english: When corn seeds are planted too close to each other, they fight for sunlight and soil nutrients. This competition makes them stretch tall and weak, resulting in small ears.
ga: Kɛji adu ŋmãa dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ Amɛbaatswa hulu la kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Nɛkɛ akaŋshii nɛɛ haa amɛkpãa amɛhe kɛyaa shɔŋŋ ni amɛhe waaa, ni no haa amɛfeɔ toi bibii.

english: Will my wilting crops recover if rain falls after a long dry spell?
ga: Ani miŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo lɛ baaná hewalɛ ekoŋŋ kɛji nugbɔ nɛ yɛ hɔmɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ sɛɛ?

english: Most crops can recover after a brief dry spell once rain returns, but if the drought lasts too long and damages the root system, the crop may survive but produce a smaller harvest.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ ateŋ babaoo baanyɛ aya hiɛ yɛ hulutsoo be kuku ko sɛɛ. Kɛ nugbɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ eba Shi kɛji hɔmɔ lɛ hi shi be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ ni efite shishifãi lɛ, Nibii ni aduɔ lɛ baanyɛ ahi shi shi amɛwoɔ yibii fioo.

english: Why do my young plants wilt after I apply fertilizer to them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi dumɔwui lɛ gboɔ beni mikɛ amɛ wo mli lɛ?

english: Applying fertilizer too close to crop stems or on dry soil burns the roots. Fertilizer should always be applied a few inches away from the stem when the soil is moist after rain.
ga: Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii wo tso lɛ shishi tsɔ loo shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ lɛ, ebaashã shishifãi lɛ. Esa akɛ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli yɛ he ko ni kɛ tso lɛ yitso lɛ teŋ jɛkɛmɔ ji inchi fioo ko pɛ beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ sɛɛ.

english: Do liquid crop booster sprays really make vegetables grow bigger fruit?
ga: Ani nu ni akɛshwieɔ tsei anɔ oya lɛ haa aduawai kɛ aduawai feɔ wuji diɛŋtsɛ?

english: Liquid sprays feed nutrients directly through leaves for a quick energy boost, but they work best as an addition to healthy soil, not a complete replacement for soil nutrients.
ga: Nu ni akɛshwieɔ nɔ lɛ haa niyenii mli hewalɛ nii kɛtsɔɔ baai lɛ anɔ tɛ̃ɛ koni eha hewalɛ aya hiɛ oya. Shi nu ni akɛshwieɔ nɔ lɛ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni akɛfataa he. Jeee nɔ ko ni yeɔ niyenii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ najiaŋ kwraa.

english: Why should I replace my old, unproductive cocoa trees with new seedlings?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mikɛ dumɔwui heei awo kookoo tsei momo ni tsuuu nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ anajiaŋ lɛ?

english: Old cocoa trees become weak and yield fewer pods over time. Planting new hybrid seedlings gives your farm fresh energy with trees that grow faster, fight off diseases better, and produce much higher yields.
ga: Kokoo tsei ni egbɔ lɛ gbɔjɔɔ ni amɛwoɔ yibii fioo yɛ be ni sa mli. Hybrid dumɔwui heei ni ooodu lɛ baaha oŋmɔ lɛ mli tsei ni daa oya lɛ aya hiɛ ekoŋŋ. Wuuɔ helai jogbaŋŋ ni ehaa yibii babaoo baa

english: Why are the leaves on my maize plants turning yellow and dying from the bottom up?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi ŋmãa tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛmiigboi kɛmiijɛ shishi kɛmiiya ŋwɛi lɛ?

english: Yellow leaves starting at the bottom usually mean your crops are hungry for nitrogen. Rain can wash this plant food deep into the dirt where short roots cannot reach it.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni jeɔ shishi kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen he miihia onibii. Nugbɔ baanyɛ afɔ tso nɛɛ niyenii lɛ he kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shɔŋŋ yɛ he ni eshishifãi kukuji lɛ nyɛɛɛ ashɛ lɛ.

english: If I plant cassava on the exact same plot of land every season, why do my yields keep getting smaller?
ga: Kɛji midu ŋmei yɛ he kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ daa be Mɛni hewɔ mi nibii ni mikɛtsuɔ nii lɛ miiba shi lɛ?

english: Cassava plants draw heavy nutrients out of the earth each season. Planting them repeatedly without resting the land or adding manure leaves the soil completely starved of plant food.
ga: Cassava tsei gbalaa niyenii ni tsii kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli daa be. Kɛ́ adu tso lɛ shii abɔ ni ekɛ ehe ejɔɔɔ ehe loo ekɛ sũ lɛ wooo mli lɛ, ebaanyɛ eha tso lɛ aná niyenii kpakpai kwraa.

english: Why do my cowpea plants grow lots of big green leaves but very few seed pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea tso lɛ yɛ baai agboi babaoo ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ? Shi dumɔwui ŋmɔji fioo pɛ yɔɔ.

english: When cowpea plants get too much nitrogen food from the soil, they put all their energy into making thick leaves instead of producing flowers and seed pods.
ga: Kɛji akɛ tsina tsei lɛ ná niyenii ni nitrogen babaoo yɔɔ mli kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, tsina kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii ni ekɛwoɔ baai ni mli tse. Mohu ɔ, e woɔ fɔfɔi kɛ dumɔwuhi.

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings shrivel up and die when the dry season begins?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cacao tsei bibii lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ yɛ hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Young cocoa plants have delicate leaves that burn quickly in direct sunlight. They need temporary shade crops like plantains planted next to them to shelter them from the hot sun during their early years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ baai ni yɔɔ mlɛo ni shãa oya kɛji hulu lɛ tso amɛ tɛ̃ɛ. Tsei ni haa amɛnáa hulutsoo be kukuoo ko, tamɔ plantains ni adu yɛ amɛmasɛi lɛ he miihia amɛ. Koni abu he kɛjɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ he yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli

english: Why do my cassava stems grow very tall and thin without forming big tubers underground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii tsei lɛ daraa ni amɛfeɔ mlɛo waa ni amɛkwɛɛɛ shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii wuji lɛ?

english: When cassava plants are placed too close together, they fight for sunlight and put all their strength into growing tall to reach the light rather than storing food in underground roots.
ga: Kɛji adu ŋmei ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Ebaatswa hulu la he akaŋ ni ebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ekwɛ̃ koni enine ashɛ la nɔ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni akɛ niyenii baato shikpɔŋ shishi shishifãi amli lɛ

english: Plantain trees have shallow roots near the surface rather than deep roots. When heavy bunches of plantains grow, the top becomes heavy and easily pulls the shallow roots out of wet dirt.
ga: Dumɔwui lɛ yɛ shishifãi ni mli ekɔɔɔ ni bɛŋkɛɔ nu lɛ hiɛ fe shishifãi ni mli kwɔ. Kɛ plantains babaoo dara lɛ Tsoi lɛ ashishifãi lɛ tsii ni amɛgbalaa shishifãi ni mli ekwɔɔɔ lɛ anɔ. Ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ ni efɔ lɛ nɔ oya

english: Why are the leaves on my okra plants curling up and feeling sticky to touch?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi gumbo tso lɛ nɔ lɛ ebɔle ehe ni enuɔ he akɛ ewa kɛji ota he lɛ?

english: Tiny insects like aphids hide under the leaves and suck out the sweet liquid inside the plant, causing the leaves to curl up and leaving a sticky waste behind.
ga: Kplukai bibii tamɔ aphids lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ baai lɛ ashishi ni amɛmuɔ nu ni ŋɔɔ ni yɔɔ tso lɛ mli lɛ. Enɛ haa baai lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛshiɔ jwɛi ni shwieɔ shi.

english: Why do weeds on my field grow so much faster than the food crops I planted?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ daa oya fe niyenii ni miduɔ lɛ?

english: Weeds are wild, tough plants that suck up water and plant food from the ground much faster than farm crops, taking away the food your crops need to grow.
ga: Jwɛi ji koo mli tsei ni wa. Ekɛ nu shwieɔ shi ni ekwɛɔ niyenii kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oya fe ŋmɔ mli tsei. Efiteɔ niyenii ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛkwɛ̃ lɛ.

english: Pepper plants drop their flowers when they face heat stress or lack water, choosing to save their energy to stay alive rather than putting effort into making fruit.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ amɛkpe yɛ hulutsoo loo nu ni bɛ mli lɛ mli. Kɛtsɔ hewalɛ ni ooohala akɛ ebaato koni ehi wala mli moŋ fe ni ooobɔ mɔdɛŋ ni otsu nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ.

english: Why do the bottoms of my tomato fruits turn black and rotten while still on the vine?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tomato aduawai shishi feɔ ediŋŋ ni egboɔ be mli ni eyɔɔ wain tso lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ?

english: This problem happens when the plant gets irregular water, which prevents it from taking up enough calcium from the dirt to build strong fruit walls.
ga: Naagba nɛɛ baa kɛji tsei lɛ ná nu yɛ gbɛ ni ejaaa nɔ. Enɛ haaa amɛná calcium ni fa bɔ ni sa kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛkɛma aduawai gbogboi ni wa.

english: Why do most farmers in Ghana clear and prepare land manually with hoes and cutlasses instead of using heavy machines like combine harvesters?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ okwaafoi ni yɔɔ Ghana lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo kɛ amɛdɛŋ tsuɔ nii kɛjieɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛsaa lɛ? Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni akɛ tsɔnei ni tsii tamɔ tsɔnei ni akɛkpaa nii lɛ baatsu nii

english: Combine harvesters are expensive machines designed for giant, flat, single-crop fields like commercial wheat or rice farms. In Ghana, most small farms have uneven terrain, mixed crops, or tree stumps, making manual clearing and harvesting with simple hand tools more practical and affordable.
ga: Combine harvesters ji tsɔnei ni jara wa ni afee aha ŋmɔji wuji komekomei, tamɔ jarayeli ŋmaa loo ŋmãa ŋmɔji. Yɛ Ghana lɛ, ŋmɔji bibii babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni etseee, ŋmɔshi nibii ni efutu, loo tsei akutsei, ni no haa ewaa akɛ akɛ niji tsuɔ nii kɛjieɔ ŋmɔji kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛ niji tsuɔ nii yɛ mli lɛ. Etsuɔ nii diɛŋtsɛ ni ejara waaa.

english: Why do I need to make soil mounds or ridges before planting root crops like yam or sweet potatoes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni mafee gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ dani madu shishifãi tamɔ ŋmei loo ŋmei?

english: Soft, raised soil in mounds gives growing roots and tubers space to expand easily underground without fighting hard soil. Ridges also help rainwater drain away so the tubers do not sit in soggy dirt and rot.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ ni nɔ kwɔ ni yɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ haa shishifãi kɛ ŋmeii ni miida lɛ naa hegbɛ ni amɛgbɛɔ amɛshwãa yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi mlɛo ni ehe ehiaaa ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ ni wa akawu. Gbɛjegbɛ lɛ hu haa nugbɔ nu lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa. Enɛ ji koni ŋmeii lɛ akabote shikpɔŋ ni mli ewo fɔ mli ni amɛkafite.

english: Why do my crops grow much better when I remove all weeds before planting my seeds?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nii lɛ daa jogbaŋŋ waa kɛ́ mijie jwɛi lɛ fɛɛ dani midu dumɔwui lɛ?

english: Weeds act like aggressive neighbors that steal sunlight, water, and soil nutrients away from your crops. Clearing weeds early ensures your young seedlings get all the food and water they need to establish strong roots.
ga: Jwɛi feɔ amɛnii tamɔ akutsoŋbii ni yɔɔ basabasa ni juɔ hulu la, nu, kɛ shikpɔŋ mli nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ onibii amli. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ mra Enɛ baaha dumɔwui bibii lɛ aná niyenii kɛ nu ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛná shishifãi ni wa.

english: How do I know if my harvested maize is dry enough to safely put into storage bags?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ mi-abele ni mikpaa lɛ mli egbi bɔ ni sa ni manyɛ mawo baagi mli shweshweeshwe?

english: Maize needs to reach a low moisture level—around 12 to 14 percent—before storage. You can test this without a moisture meter by biting a grain; if it feels very hard and makes a sharp cracking sound without flattening, it is dry enough to store without rotting.
ga: Esa akɛ ŋmãa lɛ mli ŋmɔtɔ ni baa shi aaafee oha mlijaa 12 kɛyashi 14 dani akɛto. Obaanyɛ oka enɛ okwɛ ni okɛ moisture meter tsuuu nii kɛtsɔ ŋmãa ŋmãa ni oootsɔ mli lɛ nɔ. Kɛji enu he akɛ ewa waa ni efee gbee ni naa wa ni ekɛfeee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ egbi bɔ ni sa ni abaanyɛ akɛto ni efiteee.

english: Why do my stored cocoa beans develop mold inside the bags even when the outside surface feels dry?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo ŋmeii ni mikɛto lɛ etsɔ ŋmɔtɔ yɛ kotoku lɛ mli lɛ? Kɛji akɛ kponɔgbɛ lɛ mli egbi po

english: Cocoa beans trap moisture deep inside their core. If you do not ferment and sun-dry them long enough for the inside moisture to drop below 8 percent, the hidden moisture will cause mold to grow once the beans are packed in airtight bags.
ga: Cocoa ŋmeii lɛ kɛ nu toɔ amɛmli shɔŋŋ. Kɛji akɛ okɛ ŋmeii lɛ efɔɔɔ ni ogbiɔ amɛ be kakadaŋŋ bɔ ni sa koni ŋmeii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ aba shi kɛyashɛ oha mlijaa 8 lɛ, ŋmeii ni yɔɔ teemɔŋ lɛ baaha ŋmeii aba beni akɛ ŋmeii lɛ woɔ vacuum mli lɛ.

english: Why do the leaves of my young maize plants roll up into tight tubes during hot afternoons?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-baby corn tsei lɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛfeɔ tsɔnei ni mli wa yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Rolling leaves is a defense mechanism. When the sun gets extremely hot, maize rolls its leaves to shrink the surface area exposed to sunlight, preventing water from evaporating out of the plant.
ga: Baai ni gbeeɔ shi lɛ ji gbɛ ni atsɔɔ nɔ abuɔ he. Kɛ hulu lɛ mli edɔ waa lɛ, Abɛi shwieɔ ebaai lɛ anɔ koni ekɛha he ni hulu la lɛ shɛɔ nɔ lɛ afee bibioo. Etsiɔ nu naa koni ekajɛ tso lɛ mli.

english: Why do my cassava plants drop all their leaves during the dry season, and does it mean my crop is dying?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava tso lɛ baai fɛɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ fɛ̃i be mli lɛ? Ni ani no tsɔɔ akɛ miŋmɔshi nibii miigboi?

english: Cassava plants shed their leaves during dry weather to conserve water and survive drought. The plant is not dying; it goes into a resting state above ground while keeping the edible tubers safe and growing below the soil.
ga: Cassava tsei shwieɔ amɛbaai lɛ yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be mli koni amɛkɛbu nu he ni amɛhi shi yɛ nugbɔshiimɔi amli. Tso lɛ gbooo, eboteɔ hejɔɔmɔ shihilɛ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ yɛ be mli ni ehaa ŋmeii ni ayeɔ lɛ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe ni edaa yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi.

english: Why do my pepper plants stay short and yield small fruits when I plant them close together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tsei lɛ feɔ kuku ni amɛwoɔ yibii bibii kɛji akɛ adu amɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe lɛ?

english: Crowded plants fight each other for root space, soil nutrients, and sunlight. Proper spacing allows every pepper plant to expand its roots and leaves fully, resulting in taller plants and bigger peppers.
ga: Tsei ni ebɔle amɛhe lɛ wuɔ koni amɛná shishifãi ahe gbɛ. Niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ hulu la. Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ he lɛ haa pepper tsei fɛɛ shwereɔ amɛshishifãi kɛ amɛbaai lɛ amli kwraa. Enɛ haa tsei ni kwɔlɔ kɛ ŋmeii wuji baa.

english: Yellowing bottom leaves usually indicate a lack of nitrogen in the soil. The plant copes with this shortage by taking nitrogen from its older bottom leaves and moving it up to nourish the young, growing leaves at the top.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai lɛ ashishigbɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ sũ lɛ mli. Tsei kpeɔ nɛkɛ shweremɔ nɛɛ naa kɛtsɔ nitrogen ni amɛjieɔ kɛjɛɔ baai ni egbɔ ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ amli ni amɛjieɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi koni amɛkɛha baai bibii ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ niyenii.

english: Why do insect pests suddenly swarm my cowpea crop as soon as the plants start flowering?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai shwieɔ mi-cowpea tsei lɛ anɔ kɛji amɛje fɔfɔii afeemɔ shishi pɛ?

english: Cowpea flowers produce sweet nectar and tender buds that attract destructive insects looking for energy-rich food. Protecting the plants right before and during the flowering stage prevents insects from destroying the flowers before they turn into cowpea pods.
ga: Cowpea fɔfɔii lɛ woɔ ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii bibii ni gbalaa kooloi ni fiteɔ nii ni taoɔ niyenii ni hewalɛ eyi mli obɔ lɛ. Kɛ́ abu tsei ahe dani amɛwo fɔfɔii kɛ be mli ni amɛwoɔ fɔfɔi lɛ, ebaatsi kooloi bibii anaa koni amɛkafite fɔfɔi lɛ dani amɛtsɔ tsina ŋmeii.

english: No, planting too close forces crops to compete for sunlight, water, and soil nutrients. Proper spacing gives roots enough room to swell and produce large, healthy tubers.
ga: Dabi, kɛ́ adu tso lɛ ni ebɛŋkɛ tsɔ lɛ, ebaaha tso lɛ abɔi hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ haa shishifãi lɛ náa gbɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa koni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ni amɛfee ŋmeii wuji ni mli wa.

english: It is best to wait for two or three steady, deep rains so the soil holds enough moisture. Planting after the very first light rain can cause seeds to dry out and die if the sun returns.
ga: Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ ooomɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa shii enyɔ loo etɛ be fɛɛ be koni shikpɔŋ lɛ aná ŋmɔtɔ ni fa bɔ ni sa. Dumɔ yɛ nugbɔ fioo sɛɛ Enɛ baanyɛ aha dumɔwui lɛ agbi ni amɛgboi kɛji hulu lɛ ku esɛɛ eba.

english: Why do I need to weed my farm multiple times before harvesting my maize?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafolɔ jwɛi kɛjɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli shii abɔ dani makpa ŋmãa lɛ?

english: Weeds grow faster than crops and steal water, sunlight, and fertilizer meant for your maize. Clearing weeds regularly ensures your crop gets all the food it needs to grow strong.
ga: Jwɛi lɛ daa oya fe ŋmɔshi nibii ni amɛjuɔ nu, hulu la, kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii kɛhaa o-ŋmãa lɛ. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ daa lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni okwɛɔ koni onibii lɛ aná niyenii ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛkwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why should I trim off some of the leafy branches from my tomato plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafolɔ tsei niji ni yɔɔ baai lɛ ekomɛi kɛjɛ mi-tomato tsei lɛ amli lɛ?

english: Pruning extra leaves and branches helps the plant direct its energy into growing large, healthy tomatoes instead of wasting energy on excess stems.
ga: Baai kɛ niji krokomɛi ni afoɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ yaa tomatoi wuji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni miida lɛ anɔ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni ooofite hewalɛ babaoo yɛ tsei ahe lɛ

english: Why should I change the crop I plant on my field every season instead of planting maize every year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ matsake ŋmɔshi nibii ni miduɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli daa afi lɛ moŋ fe ni madu ŋmãa daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting the same crop continuously drains the same nutrients from the soil and allows specific pests to build up. Rotating different crops keeps the soil fertile and breaks insect life cycles.
ga: Tsei kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ ni aduɔ lɛ haa niyenii mli hewalɛ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli be fɛɛ be. ni ehaa tsɛŋemɔ helai komɛi buaa amɛhe naa. Nibii srɔtoi ni aduɔ lɛ ni atsakeɔ Eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni efiteɔ kooloi ashihilɛ.

english: Why is it helpful to leave dry leaves and grass on top of the soil around my plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ ashi baai ni egboi kɛ jwɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ebɔle he lɛ nɔ? No hewɔ lɛ mitsei lɛ ahe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ.

english: Covering the soil acts like a blanket that traps moisture, protects roots from hot sun, and breaks down over time to enrich the soil.
ga: Mulching tsuɔ nii tamɔ blanket, ni emɔɔ ŋmɔtɔ. Buu shishifãi ahe kɛjɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ he. ni amɛfiteɔ yɛ be ni sa mli koni amɛha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ.

english: Why do certified hybrid seeds give a better yield than the seeds I save from my previous harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni akɛfee nibii krokomɛi ni awo he odaseyeli lɛ woɔ yibii kpakpai fe dumɔwui ni mikɛto kɛjɛ kpamɔ ko ni eho lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Certified hybrid seeds are specially bred to fight off local diseases and produce high yields, whereas saved seeds lose their vigor and yield less each generation.
ga: Akwɛɔ dumɔwui ni akɛfee nibii krokomɛi ni yɔɔ hegbɛ lɛ krɛdɛɛ koni amɛkɛwu amɛshi maŋ lɛ mli helai ni amɛwo yibii babaoo. Yɛ nakai beaŋ lɛ, dumɔwui ni ato he gbɛjianɔ lɛ ahewalɛ baa shi ni amɛwoɔ yibii fioo yɛ yinɔ fɛɛ yinɔ mli.

english: Can I put fertilizer on my farm right when I put the seeds in the ground?
ga: Ani manyɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo miŋmɔ lɛ mli kɛji mikɛ dumɔwui lɛ wo shikpɔŋ lɛ mli pɛ?

english: It is better to wait until seeds sprout and develop young roots. Applying fertilizer too early can burn delicate seeds or get washed away by heavy rain before roots can feed on it.
ga: Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ ooomɛ ni dumɔwui lɛ akwɛ̃ ni amɛná shishifãi bibii. Kɛ́ akɛ dumɔwui ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ wo mli mra lɛ, ebaanyɛ eha dumɔwui ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ ashã loo nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ ahoo amɛ dani shishifãi lɛ aye amɛ.

english: Leaf curling is usually caused by tiny sucking insects like aphids or thrips feeding on leaf sap and spreading plant diseases. Treating the insects early helps normal leaf growth return.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ aphids loo thrips ni yeɔ baa lɛ mli nu lɛ kɛ tsei ahe helai ni gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baa lɛ shwieɔ shi. Kplukai ahe tsamɔ mra Eyeɔ ebuaa baai lɛ ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛdaraa bɔ ni sa.

english: Young cocoa plants cannot handle harsh direct sunlight without shade. Without shade trees like plantains or proper watering, intense dry season heat quickly dries out their delicate leaves.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii nyɛŋ akpɛlɛ hulu la ni naa wa ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ nɔ kɛji hulutsoo be bɛ amɛhe. Kɛji tsei komɛi bɛ ni baaha hulutsoo aba, tamɔ dumɔwui loo nu ni sa, Latsaa ni naa wa ni baa yɛ fɛ̃i be lɛ mli lɛ haa baai ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ gbɛ́ɔ oya.

english: Why are the leaves on my young maize plant turning light yellow instead of dark green?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-baby corn tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni mli tse yɛ ŋmɔŋ ni mli edɔ najiaŋ lɛ?

english: Yellow leaves usually mean the soil lacks nitrogen, which is the main nutrient maize needs to build green leaves and grow big. Adding manure or a nitrogen-rich fertilizer helps the leaves turn green and healthy again.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ji niyenii titri ko ni he hiaa ŋmãa koni ebaakwɛ baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni etsɔ agbo. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni baai lɛ afee ŋmɔji ni amɛhe wa ekoŋŋ.

english: Why does growing cowpeas on my farm make the soil better for my next maize crop?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tsina ŋmeii ni aduɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ afee nɔ ni hi kɛha ŋmãa ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Cowpeas are legumes, which means their roots have special microscopic helpers that trap nitrogen gas from the air and store it in the soil, naturally fertilizing the ground for future crops.
ga: Cowpea ji ŋmãa tso. Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ amɛshishifãi lɛ yɛ nibii krɛdɛɛi ni yeɔ ebuaa ni amɛmɔɔ nitrogen gas ni jɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli lɛ ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Koni efee adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii kɛha shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii akwɛmɔ wɔsɛɛ.

english: Why does rain water sit on top of my field for days without soaking into the dirt?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ nugbɔ nu lɛ hiɔ ŋmãa ŋmɔji anɔ gbii babaoo ni ekɛ ehe wooo shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: When heavy soil gets compacted from animals walking on it or continuous farming, it forms a hard surface layer that blocks water. Mixing dry organic matter or compost into the soil helps loosen it so water can drain properly.
ga: Beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ waa kɛjɛ kooloi ni nyiɛɔ nɔ loo okwaayeli ni yaa nɔ lɛ mli. Shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ nɔ ko ni wa ni tsiɔ nu naa. Kɛ́ okɛ nibii ni egbi loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ futu mli lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni eha egbɔjɔ koni nu lɛ atsɔ mli jogbaŋŋ.

english: How can I tell that my cassava tubers under the ground are mature and ready for harvesting?
ga: Te ooofee tɛŋŋ ole akɛ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ edara ni esa akɛ akpa?

english: When cassava is ready (usually 9 to 12 months after planting), the lower leaves turn yellow and fall off, leaving a bare stem, and the ground right around the base of the plant starts cracking open as the roots swell.
ga: Kɛji akɛ ŋmei lɛ efee klalo (bei pii lɛ, nyɔji 9 kɛyashi 12 sɛɛ beni adu lɛ), shishigbɛ baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛshwieɔ shi. Tso lɛ shishifãi ni bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ eshwɛ ni he ni ebɔle tso lɛ shishi lɛ jeɔ shishi egbɛɔ eshwaa be mli ni shishifãi lɛ shwereɔ lɛ.

english: Why do my plantain leaves roll up tightly into tubes during the dry season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi plantain baai lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ ni amɛfeɔ tsɔne yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Plantain leaves curl up during hot, dry weather to reduce the surface area exposed to the sun, which stops the plant from losing too much water through its leaves.
ga: Plantain baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔɔ ni egbiɔ lɛ koni ekɛba he ni hulu la lɛ shɛɔ nɔ lɛ shi. Enɛ baatsi tsei lɛ anaa koni amɛkatsɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ amɛje nu babaoo.

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when they suffer heat stress or dry soil because they do not have enough water energy to support growing fruits, so regular watering at root level helps save the blooms.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ amɛyashɛ hulutsoo loo shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, nu hewalɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni baaha aduawai akwɛ̃ lɛ bɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ afɔ nu daa yɛ shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni fɔfɔi lɛ aya nɔ ahi shi.

english: Why do I need to put long tall sticks next to my yam plants as they grow?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mikɛ tsei kakadaji ni kwɔlɔ fɔ̃ɔ sweet potato tsei lɛ ahe beni amɛdaraa lɛ?

english: Yam is a climbing vine that needs maximum sunlight on its leaves to produce food for the root underground; lifting the vines onto tall sticks keeps the leaves in the light and away from moist ground diseases.
ga: Sweet potatoes ji wain tsei ni kwɔɔ ni biɔ hulu la babaoo yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni amɛná niyenii amɛha amɛshishifãi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ. Kɛ́ awó wein tso lɛ nɔ yɛ tsei niji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ anɔ lɛ, ehaa baai lɛ naa la ni ehaa helai baaa amɛnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ edɔ nɔ.

english: Why do my small green cocoa pods turn black and shrivel up on the branches before they mature?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kookoo ŋmɔji bibii ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ No hewɔ lɛ minɔ lɛ tsɔɔ ediŋŋ ni egboɔ yɛ tsei lɛ aniji anɔ dani amɛdaraa lɛ?

english: This is caused by Black Pod disease, a fungus that spreads rapidly in wet, shaded conditions. Clearing excess farm shade and removing infected pods right away keeps the fungus from spreading to healthy pods.
ga: Black pod hela lɛ kɛ enɛ baa. Enɛ ji ŋmei ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni efɔ kɛ hei ni hulutsoo yɔɔ lɛ. Ajieɔ hulutsoo ni fa fe nine yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli kɛ ŋmeii ni hela emɔ amɛ lɛ ajiemɔ oya Enɛ baaye abua ni ŋmeii lɛ akagbɛ ashwã ŋmeii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ amli.

english: Small holes in young corn leaves are usually caused by tiny armyworm caterpillars eating their way out from deep inside the central leaf funnel of the plant.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmeii bibii ni ji ŋmei bibii lɛ kɛ ŋmeii bibii ni yɔɔ ŋmei baai amli lɛ baa. Eyeɔ gbɛ ni etsɔɔ nɔ ejeɔ kpo kɛjɛɔ tso lɛ teŋgbɛ baa lɛ mli shɔŋŋ.

english: Why are the new leaves on my pepper bushes curling up and looking wrinkled?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai heei ni yɔɔ mi-pepper bush lɛ nɔ lɛ ebɔle amɛhe ni etamɔ nɔ ni ebɔle amɛhe lɛ?

english: Curled, wrinkled pepper leaves are usually caused by tiny insects like aphids or mites sucking sap from the underside of the leaves, which distorts the leaf as it grows.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ aphids loo mites ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ baai lɛ ashishi lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ pepper baai ni shwieɔ shi lɛ baa. Enɛ baaha baai lɛ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ beni amɛdaraa lɛ.

english: Yellow leaves usually mean your maize is starving for nitrogen, which is the main nutrient plants need to grow green and strong. It can also happen when heavy rains wash nutrients deep into the soil where roots cannot reach.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-corn lɛ mli. Enɛ ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛhe wa. Ebaanyɛ eba hu kɛ́ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ hoɔ niyenii mli nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shɔŋŋ yɛ he ni shishifãi nyɛɛɛ ashɛ he lɛ.

english: Why is my cassava growing very tall with plenty of leaves, but giving me small, thin roots?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmei daa ni eyɛ baai babaoo shi eyɛ shishifãi bibii ni yɔɔ mlɛo nɛkɛ lɛ?

english: Too much nitrogen in the soil makes cassava focus all its energy on growing leaves and stems instead of tubers. Cassava needs balanced soil rich in potassium to build big, heavy roots.
ga: Nitrogen ni fa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ haa ŋmei lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ baai kɛ tsei ni miida lɛ ahe nii moŋ fe ŋmeii. Yucca he miihia shikpɔŋ ni ja ni potassium eyi mli obɔ lɛ koni enyɛ efee shishifãi wuji ni tsii.

english: Why is it bad for my land if I keep planting maize on the exact same field every season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ ehiii kɛji midu ŋmãa yɛ ŋmɔ kome mli daa be lɛ?

english: Planting maize continuously drains the same nutrients from the soil year after year and allows maize pests and diseases to build up in the earth. Rotating with legumes like beans or groundnuts puts nitrogen back into the soil naturally.
ga: Abɛi ni aduɔ lɛ jieɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli daa afi. ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ŋmãa mli tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ helai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ́ okɛ ŋmeii tamɔ ŋmeii loo ŋmeii tsake lɛ, no baaha nitrogen aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ adebɔɔ naa.

english: Why do my vegetable leaves droop during the hot afternoon sun but stand up straight again by morning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ aduawai shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ mli, shi amɛdamɔ shi jaŋŋ ekoŋŋ leebi lɛ?

english: In hot afternoon heat, plants lose water through their leaves faster than their roots can drink it from the soil, so they wilt to protect themselves. Overnight, when it cools down, roots catch up and refill the plant with water.
ga: Yɛ shwane mli beni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔ waa lɛ Tsei lɛ laajeɔ nu kɛtsɔɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ oya fe bɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ baanyɛ anu kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, tsei miisumɔ ni amɛbu amɛhe. Gbi gbɛkɛ beni edɔ lɛ Shishifãi lɛ baaje kpo ni amɛkɛ nu baafata tso lɛ he.

english: This rot happens when the plant cannot absorb enough calcium to form strong fruit walls, usually caused by irregular watering where the soil dries out completely and is then suddenly flooded.
